scope: Existing local USB ring-cycle and event-router cases reachable through explicit Spectra CHECK USB.

implementation.ownership: Production USB owner functions and their two original self_test bodies remain byte-identical. A tiny native R4DEV wrapper calls them directly; Spectra owns selection and common text/JSON/export. No copied implementation in userland.
implementation.cases: Original800ring submissions, repeated cycle/link wraps and final enqueue/producer/link state. Original exact HID/storage/command event matching, out-of-order extraction and final empty local mailbox. Independent attempted/passed/failed group masks.
implementation.lifetime: Only private caller-stack state. No allocation, waits, callbacks, new tasks, session/gate or persistent probe data. Reentrant and repeatable; caller output is retained only for the synchronous call.
implementation.hardware_boundary: No real TRB submission, controller/port reset or productive mailbox/queue access. No USB hardware is required. This does not qualify physical USB devices or USB liveboot.
implementation.api: Append-only R4DEVv20 slot54@448,total456; fixed32-byte ProgramKernelUsbCheck v1, only eightu32fields. Old448-byte layout prefix/types/constants and technical ABI retained; exact published Contract0.64.17/SDK0.64.29 pins required before final build.

contract_pin.source: exact published GitHub archive, clean owner, pinned Zig fetch
contract_pin.kernel_binding: exact published Git revision; no local binding

sdk_pin.source: exact published GitHub archive, pinned repository-context Zig fetch

validation.contract_gate: Existing26compatibility mutations and native C/Zig/Rust host/bare layout/callback gate passed. All old448-byte layout prefix/types/constants and technical ABI preserved.
validation.host_validation_correction: Guest passed on first run. Host expected reserved0 in serialized output; common output intentionally omits reserved fields. Client already checks it before returning0. Corrected only host validation against the existing log; no guest/runtime change or repeat.

scoped.evidence: Checks/result.json and serial.log in ignored archive

comparison_previous_release.observation: Final overall change -3.033168% versus0.84.15. Notable measured area changes: filesystem_io -23.996827%, memory 5.895789%. One final run per release does not establish causality. STANDARD does not directly measure the USB contract; no extra run for scores.

test_policy.minimal: One targeted SMP4 guest with repeat, invalid args/headers and capacity-tail checks, existing Contract ABI/build gates, and one mandatory final STANDARD.
test_policy.quick_waiver: No production USB function or normal kernel body changed. The scoped guest and final STANDARD cover current kernel boot/new API; no unrelated Quick/catalog repetition (Agents/Test.txt: targeted cases, Quick when needed).

performance_policy.reason: Kernel code reachability/table layout changes can affect runtime; uncertainty requires exactly one final Suite2 STANDARD SMP4 and verified original5/30/6 DevCenter import. STANDARD does not directly measure the USB contract.

limits: Synthetic native contract evidence only; no physical USB/USB-liveboot qualification.
Full genuine exports/raw samples and guest logs remain outside Git.
